recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片上的顆粒（particle）幾乎全由脂肪空泡與網狀基質組成，造血細胞極少，只剩散在的基質細胞核，呈現放射治療後的骨髓再生不良。
features: Marrow particle composed of a delicate stromal meshwork with numerous fat vacuoles
Marked paucity of hematopoietic cells within the particle
Scattered small spindle to oval stromal/endothelial nuclei
Occasional dark pigment granules in the stroma
Background of fat droplets with few red cells and nucleated cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a particle composed almost entirely of fat vacuoles and a delicate stromal network with scattered stromal nuclei. Hematopoietic precursors are markedly reduced to nearly absent within the particle, and the background contains few nucleated cells. No infiltrating tumor cells are identified. Findings indicate a markedly hypocellular, fatty marrow particle consistent with post-radiation marrow aplasia in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Idiopathic aplastic anemia produces identical empty fatty particles, so distinction relies on history of radiation, and PNH clone or telomere studies.
Serous atrophy shows pink-purple amorphous extracellular ground substance and small fat cells, often with cachexia, rather than a clean fat-stromal meshwork.
Hypocellular MDS retains residual dysplastic hematopoietic islands and may show clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
